player_prompt.intro:
O mmoki {player_id} mo JoJoJoin, e e dulwang mo borong ya 5x5 e e nang le matsela a suleng a 0-24.
Ka nako ya gago, belegetsa tshwele ya gago mo seleng se se khutshwane, e.g. '[12]'.
O FITLHA ka go tshelela DINNE di a mantsi a gago a a tsalanang — matsela a manne a a tsalanang ka mokgwa o o latellanang, kwa godimo, kwa tlase, kgotsa ka tshukudu.
Ele mmoki {player_id} o '{symbol}'; mmoki wa gago o '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tshedimosetso e o rometsweng ka yone ga se ya mofuta wa yone.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ga se sele e e nepagetseng. E tshwanetse go nna magareng a 0 le 24.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o belegetswe tshwele ya gagwe ({symbol}) mo seleng {cell}.
